IPT.evidence_source: [block_0] The Positive Thoughts and Action (PTA) program is a cognitive-behavioral intervention designed to prevent and reduce depressive symptoms in early adolescents.

male_pct.evidence_source: [block_1] Participants were 120 early adolescents (Mage = 12.5 years, SD = 0.6; 58% female)

dxgive.evidence_source: [block_1] Participants were included if they scored above the clinical cutoff on the Children’s Depression Inventory (CDI; Kovacs, 1992) and did not meet criteria for a current major depressive episode based on the Kiddie Schedule for Affective Disorders and Schizophrenia for School-Age Children—Present and Lifetime Version (K-SADS-PL; Kaufman et al., 1997).

Source.evidence_source: [block_1] Children’s Depression Inventory (CDI); Kiddie Schedule for Affective Disorders and Schizophrenia for School-Age Children—Present and Lifetime Version (K-SADS-PL); [block_2] Children’s Depression Inventory (CDI), the Children’s Negative Cognitive Error Questionnaire (CNCEQ), the Children’s Attributional Style Questionnaire (CASQ), and the Social Skills Rating System (SSRS).
